title: Variable Selection for Feature-Based Newsvendor
abstract: arXiv:2609.01544v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Feature-based newsvendor models use observable covariates to tailor inventory decisions, aiming to balance holding and shortage costs under demand uncertainty. However, high-dimensional feature sets often hinder interpretability and inflate data collection and implementation costs. This paper studies variable selection for the feature-based newsvendor problem under a hard cardinality constraint on the number of selected features. We formulate the resulting $\ell_0$-constrained empirical newsvendor problem with $\ell_2$-regularization, establish its computational hardness, and develop a mixed-integer second-order cone programming reformulation that strengthens the standard Big-$M$ formulation. To enable scalability beyond exact optimization, we develop a randomized-rounding algorithm with a bi-criteria guarantee and a greedy heuristic. Statistically, we provide theoretical analysis of the resulting sparse policy estimator, including finit

translated_title: 基于特征的报童问题中的变量选择
translated_abstract: 基于特征的报童模型利用可观测的协变量来定制库存决策，旨在需求不确定性下平衡持有成本与缺货成本。然而，高维特征集合往往损害模型的可解释性，并增加数据收集与实施成本。本文研究了在所选特征数量受硬基数约束下，基于特征的报童问题的变量选择。我们对由此产生的带ℓ₂正则化的ℓ₀约束经验报童问题进行建模，证明了其计算难度，并开发了一种混合整数二阶锥规划重构方法，该方法强化了标准的Big-M公式。为了在精确优化之外实现可扩展性，我们开发了一种具有双准则保证的随机舍入算法以及一种贪心启发式算法。在统计方面，我们对所得的稀疏策略估计量提供了理论分析，包括有限样本（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文针对基于特征的报童问题，在特征数量的硬基数约束下提出变量选择方法，通过带ℓ₂正则化的ℓ₀约束建模、强化的混合整数二阶锥规划重构以及随机舍入和贪心等可扩展算法，同时给出了稀疏库存策略估计量的理论保证。
en_tdlr: This paper studies variable selection for the feature-based newsvendor under a hard cardinality constraint, formulating an ℓ₀-constrained ℓ₂-regularized empirical newsvendor problem, developing a strengthened mixed-integer second-order cone programming reformulation along with scalable randomized-rounding and greedy algorithms, and providing theoretical guarantees for the resulting sparse policy estimator.
